title: Early arrival, room not ready
summary: Synthetic facts from a PMS, a housekeeping system and a guest messaging platform for one property. Replay events.jsonl in file order through an implementation and compare its dispositions, readiness and situations with expected.json.

deliveries.note: The PMS confirms reservation res_1042, arriving today. The guest is referenced only by a pseudonymous id.
The PMS expects stay_1042 in unit 204 with the standard check-in at 15:00.
The housekeeping system, the declared authority for housekeeping status, reports unit 204 dirty after the previous guest left.
The same fact arrives again, as at-least-once delivery allows. Same source and id: it is ignored.

deliveries.checks: A task is not a status
deliveries.note: The cleaning task is reported complete. At this property only the supervisor's inspection changes the authoritative status, so the unit is still dirty.

The PMS flips unit 204 to clean because the task closed. Its manifest declares it non-authoritative for housekeeping, so HOS records the disagreement instead of merging it. A front desk trusting the PMS would hand over a room nobody released.
At 11:40 the guest writes that they will arrive around 12:30, before the 15:00 check-in. The unit is not ready: HOS raises arrival.room_readiness_at_risk with its evidence.
An earlier message (11:05, arriving 12:00) is delivered late. It is older than the 11:40 message, so it does not replace it.
The supervisor inspects unit 204 at 12:10. The authoritative status is ready 20 minutes before the guest arrives: the risk is resolved.
